1.en: By the sun and its brightness

2.en: And [by] the moon when it follows it

3.en: And [by] the day when it displays it

4.en: And [by] the night when it covers it

5.en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

6.en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

7.en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

8.en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

9.en: He has succeeded who purifies it,

10.en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

11.en: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

12.en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

13.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
13.en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

14.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
14.en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

15.en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
